description: A tenant vault, read in one call (GET /v1/vault/arm?balances=1 + GET /v1/vault/owner): its three addresses (vault · TOP-UP, where you send funds · spend) with their native balances, the caps it runs (spend per tx / day, the GRID debit, each key's caps, the program's limits), the policy_hash an arm must sign, the arm state (armed until <time> | dry | expired | stale_policy | stale_owner | no_arm) and the owner (current, pending change, recovery key). Public; nothing is signed.

vault.description: the tenant vault id, vault:tenant:<tenant> (e.g. vault:tenant:tenant-3)

name: taifoon_vault
